answer: A Sybil-resistant mechanism employs a hierarchical delta scoring system across interconnected wharves in the ocean-like network topology. Agents must authenticate through multiple wharves by contributing computationally costly证明，each wharf computing a delta value based on transaction patterns and contextual data. Sybils,检测到被多个wharves交叉验证时，面临指数级上升的delta阈值挑战，其伪造身份成本随wharves数量呈几何级数增长，有效抑制虚假节点渗透。
